scope: Source-assisted task criterion review is not learner performance.

criteria.title: cyclic-geometry
criteria.acceptance: Recover sectors 60,90,120,90 from rays 0,60,150,270 including wraparound to360; explain geometric order versus input order.

criteria.title: angular-existence
criteria.acceptance: Compute alternating totals180/180 and residual0; preserve even degree and the ideal unassigned single-interior-vertex, zero-thickness, all-used-crease hypotheses and existential conclusion.

criteria.title: radian-tolerance
criteria.acceptance: Moving e1 changes adjacent sectors with opposite signs: residual magnitude2abs(delta). Classify 1e-10 and1e-8 at tolerance1e-9rad; no degrees or material allowance inferred.

criteria.title: assignment-counterexample
criteria.acceptance: MMMV gives M-V=2 and angular pass but violates opposite labels at the strict60degree minimum with90degree neighbors. No whole IX acceptance follows.

criteria.title: coverage
criteria.acceptance: State assigned-card counts1applicable,4border,1isolated and one-U counts0applicable,1other; empty failures/max0 describe no positive coverage. Keep the incidence-model boundary.

criteria.title: prior
criteria.acceptance: Count16labeled strings with authored fair1/16 prior and entropy4bits; do not infer an actual agent sampling distribution.

criteria.title: filters
criteria.acceptance: Count8 Maekawa survivors/H3 and4 both-filter survivors/H2 under conditional uniform distributions. Preserve identities and MMMV counterexample; no full-solver or physical certificate.

criteria.title: skew
criteria.acceptance: Compute entropy1.75 for probabilities1/2,1/4,1/8,1/8 against maximum2bits over the same4states; distinguish concentration from correctness.

criteria.title: average
criteria.acceptance: For bucket sizes8/4/4 derive probabilities1/2,1/4,1/4, expected remainder2.5 and label information1.5, distinct from accepted-branch remainder2.

criteria.title: handoff
criteria.acceptance: Preserve assignment identities, crease IDs, predicates and probability assumptions. A pass label cannot reconstruct identity, and U is not a fair binary prior.

criteria.title: existential
criteria.acceptance: Replace a universal assignment claim with existence under the ideal unassigned single-vertex hypotheses; no global, thick-object or manufacturing claim follows.

criteria.title: necessity
criteria.acceptance: Use MMMV as a necessary-filter counterexample without refuting the unassigned theorem or assuming complete IX acceptance.

criteria.title: empty-domain
criteria.acceptance: Explain applicable0, empty failures and maximum0 with the unknown-crease skip reason; do not infer a checked vertex or completed assignment.

criteria.title: aggregate
criteria.acceptance: Locate the other conjuncts of the IX aggregate predicate; distinguish missing full input/frame/order/runtime verdict and local versus whole fold, stack or motion.

criteria.title: semantic-message
criteria.acceptance: Write a handoff preserving subject, identity, predicate, domain, assumptions and witness; retain MMMV extra-rule failure and missing outcomes. The DSL is proposed, with a typed report as simpler alternative.

pass_policy: All five criteria per module. Record actual answers and assistance; preserve failures.
